siteDocs.title: Title
siteDocs.pageDescription: Manage Markdown documents under /docs. Published docs are visible on your custom domain.
siteDocs.duplicateDocDescription: Copies “{{title}}” ({{locale}}): same path, body seeded from the original as a starting point for translation. The copy is created as a draft.
siteDocs.duplicateLocaleHint: Keeps the same path so both rows become translations of each other (header language switcher / hreflang).
siteDocs.duplicateLocaleTakenHint: That language already has a document at this path. Pick another language.
siteDocs.createHint: A doc is just a title + Markdown body — no section/block system. Publish to make it live.
siteDocs.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens only (e.g. quickstart). Cannot be changed after saving.
siteDocs.categoryPlaceholder: e.g. getting-started (optional; create in category manager)
siteDocs.manageCategoriesHint: Categories share one key across locales; order controls grouping on the docs index page.
siteDocs.categoryLabelRequired: Enter a name in at least one language
siteDocs.categoryDeleteFailed: Cannot delete: documents still use this category
siteDocs.categoryReorderFailed: Could not reorder categories — try again
siteDocs.noCategories: No categories yet. Create one below.
siteDocs.bodyHint: Markdown supported. Renders with the same typography as page content.
siteDocs.deleteConfirmDescription: “{{title}}” will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
siteDocs.revertConfirmDescription: The draft will revert to the last published version.
siteDocs.descriptionPlaceholder: One line on what this covers (optional)
siteDocs.discardConfirmDescription: What you edited here won't be kept.
siteDocs.emptyFilteredHint: Try another keyword, or clear the filters.

list.label: Doc list
list.categoryFilterInfo: Category key (e.g. getting-started); leave empty to list all.
list.limitInfo: 0 means no limit. Use it for a "latest docs" block on the home page.

article.label: Doc body
article.showTitleInfo: The title comes from document metadata; start the body at ##.
article.backLabelInfo: Leave empty to use the default (“Back to docs”).
article.backHrefInfo: Defaults to the docs index. Point it at a custom directory page if you have one.

nav.label: Doc navigation
nav.stickyInfo: Only on wide screens where the nav sits beside the body.

sample.title: Sample document
sample.description: Placeholder used in the preview while you have no documents yet.
sample.body:
## First section

This is sample body text. Once you publish a document, real content shows up here.

## Second section

The outline on the side is generated from these headings.
